messages:
Alex Price: Morning — quick Q re benefits enrollment. I tried to add my partner as a dependent in the benefits portal but it errors at the end (says 'dependent verification required'). Anyone know the correct docs to upload and if this delays coverage start? Thanks.

Jen Liu: @Alex Price hi! You should upload proof of relationship (marriage certificate or domestic partnership affidavit) and a government ID for the dependent. It won't block you from selecting plans, but dependent coverage won't be active until verification clears.

Alex Price: Thanks! Is verification done by People Ops or the carrier? Also what's the effective date if I enroll now — my start date is 03/10.

HR Bot: Automated reminder: benefits enrollment window open for new hires until 30 days after start. Coverage effective date: 1st of the month following enrollment completion, unless enrollment submitted on your first day before 23:59 PT (carrier exceptions possible).

Jen Liu: Carrier performs verification. People Ops will flag missing docs and can escalate. For your 03/10 start, if you finish enrollment + docs by 03/31, coverage should start 04/01. If carrier verifies quickly they sometimes apply coverage retroactively to your start date, but that is uncommon.

Alex Price: Got it. Also: dental plan network — I don't see 'BrightSmiles' listed in the carrier's quick lookup. How do I check if the specific dentist (BrightSmiles Family Dentistry) is in-network?

Sam Patel: Hi @Alex Price — use the carrier provider lookup link in the benefits portal (Benefits > Carrier Links). If you want, paste the dentist's NPI or office address here and we can check. If out-of-network, you can still enroll but claims/reimbursement will differ.

Alex Price: Cool. One more: I had relocation expenses — do I submit receipts to Finance or will the benefits portal reimburse moving costs? I remember something about a lump relocation allowance in my offer.

Sam Patel: Relocation is handled by Finance as a lump payment per your offer letter. For itemized reimbursements (if approved), submit receipts to expenses@redwood.com with category 'Relocation' and include your relocation approval ID. CC @Jen Liu if you need us to confirm amounts or tax treatment.

Jen Liu: I'll confirm whether the relocation amount is taxable (US rules apply) and whether we need to gross-up. Alex, happy to jump on a 1:1 to walk through the docs if you want — send available times.

Alex Price: Thanks both — uploading docs now. Also where do I file W-4 and state withholding? I couldn't find W-4 in the benefits portal.

HR Bot: New hires: complete W-4 and direct deposit in Workday > Personal Info > Tax Forms. If you don't complete a W-4, federal default withholding is Single, 0.

Alex Price: Done with direct deposit. W-4 is queued. I'll follow up after I upload the marriage cert. Appreciate the help :thumbsup:
